traits.name: Cling
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature leaves the swarm's space Effect The swarm takes 1d6 (1d6) damage as ants cling to the creature and continue biting, dealing 3d6 (3d6) persistent piercing damage. High winds or immersion in water reduces the DC of the flat check to end this persistent damage to 5. Any area damage dealt to the creature destroys these clinging ants.

traits.name: Swarming Bites
traits.text: ⬻ Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d6 (3d6) piercing damage (DC 21 basic Fortitude save). A creature that fails its save against Swarming Bites becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round. If the creature attempts a concentrate or manipulate action while affected, it must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the action is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.
